title: Review of c24's comet cut-regrowth: regrowth replicates but at a lower rate (5/12 informative cuts at dt 0.1, 5/8 at dt/2); core cuts that hit the head mostly kill; no set point confirmed
summary: Re-ran c24's neural-field comet world on fresh seeds 11-14 with half 40/50% and core 30/50% cuts at t=500, a 5% sham cut, and dt/2 (WORLD_P dt=0.05) variants. The sham showed one target merges within 4 t anyway; of the 12 informative dt=0.1 cuts, 5 regrow (half cuts 4/6, core cuts 1/6) and 7 die (head fades within ~30 t while the sham twin lives); at dt/2, 5/8 regrow. Regrown comets overshoot to 1.2-4.6x like undamaged comparators, so I confirm there is no set-point size. Weak: regrowth is real but less frequent than reported and depends on cut geometry and the comet.

observations.R: rerun/half50/seed14/damage.png: 50% half cut, head re-forms, 1.58x at t=540, travels until merging at t=660; rerun/half40/seed12 regrows 1.18x

seeds_run.result: uninformative: target #548 merges within 4 t even after a 5% sham cut
fail: all four cuts kill #494 within 3 t while the sham twin lives to t=611
half 40/50% and core 30% regrow (1.6x); core 50% dies

controls_run.R: rerun/sham05/ (5% sham cut of the same four comets) and the undamaged comparators in every damage.png; dt/2 in rerun/half40_dt2 and rerun/core30_dt2

verdicts.limitation: Regrowth rate on new seeds is 5/12 informative cuts at dt 0.1 (claim 6/8), half cuts 4/6 vs core cuts 1/6; four comets only, fates are strongly comet-dependent; dt/2 runs cut different comets (chaotic divergence) and had no sham. Regrowth overshoots the pre-cut size like ordinary comet growth, so this is recovery of the body plan, not repair to a set point; whether R counts for the capability gate needs a set-point world (the question's second step).
